Meta.MetaString:
Development of the Supply Chain Virtual Twin on the 3DEXPERIENCE Platform is a major strategic initiative for the DELMIA R&D Operations Optimization department. Now reaching maturity, customer implementations require scaling the Supply Chain Data Management service to support large and complex supply chains. This service is also critical to our GEN7 AI strategy, enabling world-class Generative Experiences and Virtual Companion capabilities.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Software Architect - Supply Chain Data with a strong background in Java backend development and enterprise data management to drive and engineer the data architecture from strategy to hands-on implementation and adoption, ensuring robust, reusable models for the Supply Chain Virtual Twin.

Role Description and Responsibilities

 

  • Design, code and implement the data architecture of a high-performance data service with diverse requirements: Data versioning, Data scenarios, Access control, Extensibility, Backwards compatibility, API access for client applications and Service-to-service integration.
  • Actively contribute to and guide implementation within an enterprise Java code base, translating functional requirements into production-ready technical solutions.
  • Ensure the performance, capacity and scalability of the service by applying appropriate data management technologies for various use cases. Our service makes use of both relational databases and data lakehouse technologies.
  • Support the development of high-performance front-end web applications for visualizing and authoring data, and enable Agentic AI architecture with MCP servers and agent-to-agent communication
     

 

Qualifications

 

  • Proven professional experience working within the supply chain domain, operations optimization, or complex enterprise data environments.
  • Strong, hands-on programming background with solid, production-level Java experience, alongside modern development skills (distributed systems, cloud, web and database architectures).
  • Experience in data modeling frameworks, relational databases, data lakehouse technologies, machine learning/AI data pipelines, and cloud computing environments.
  • A builder/engineer mindset with the ability to follow-up high-level architecture with hands-on code implementation, alongside strong leadership to drive modeling across organizations and functional domains.
  • Ability to communicate complex architectural concepts clearly to both engineering teams and management audiences.

 

Why Join Us?

 

  • Work on a strategic product at the heart of DELMIA's Supply Chain and AI roadmap.
  • Influence the architecture of next-generation Supply Chain Virtual Twin solutions.
  • Collaborate with global experts in Supply Chain, Data, Cloud, and AI.
  • Solve complex challenges at enterprise scale while creating tangible business impact.
  • Help shape the future of intelligent, AI-powered supply chain management.

Join our team as a Sales Executive for our DELMIA Brand and help our clients to reach their full potential!
DELMIA, a Dassault Systèmes brand, connects the virtual and real worlds to drive innovation and sustainability. Powered by the 3DEXPERIENCE platform, our end-to-end solutions integrate virtual twins, industrial AI and augmented reality to optimize manufacturing, supply chains and workforces. We empower businesses to reduce waste and achieve sustainable, customer-focused operations, building a more resilient future. 

Role Description and Responsibilities

  • Lead Customer Executive relationships and global ecosystem to support enterprise and business transformation
  • Work with clients in the industries; Transport & Mobility, Industrial Equipment, High Tech, Life Sciences, Aerospace & Defense and Marine & Offshore
  • Become part of a team, whose passion is to help our customers reach their visions and at the same time grow and expand our business across your assigned territory within the EuroNorth region (UK, Ireland, Benelux, Nordics and Baltics)
  • Build and develop trusted relationships at executive level and within all layers of the client organization
  • Meet plan objectives by addressing key customers challenges and drive value agreements
  • Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts and act as the voice of the customer within Dassault Systèmes
     

Qualifications

  • Direct software solution sales experience combined with a passion for hunting and developing new business
  • Direct experience of Software Optimization, Software Sales, Digital Manufacturing, Virtual Twin technologies, IBP, S&OP, APS, MES, MOM and/or Manufacturing Engineering etc 
  • Proven experience of managing end to end customer engagements
  • A collaborative, customer-focused mindset with strong communication and negotiation skills, intellectual curiosity and a passion for continuous learning
  • Ability to understand our software and optimization for Manufacturing and/or Supply Chain, how the customer can gain value
  • Demonstrable sales success with the ability to meet and exceed targets and focus on longer sales opportunities

What’s in it for you

  • An international and diverse working environment in a collaborative team
  • Flexible working hours with hybrid working model, a good work-life balance and comprehensive benefits package. 
  • Extensive skills and career development programs to build your journey with us.

Interested? Click on "Apply" to upload your application documents.

Meta.MetaString:
As a Legal Counsel, you will provide legal advice and support for commercial (and corporate as needed) matters in primarily Benelux, but also other EMEA countries as needed. You will be part of a team of experienced lawyers across the EMEA and you will report to the Head of Legal for Northern Europe. You will be primarily responsible for supporting the sales and services organizations and other business stakeholders, including decision makers in the organization.  

You will actively manage, draft and negotiate complex commercial agreements, particularly license and professional services agreements for commercial software products. Your main areas of focus are commercial transactions, software licensing and other related contracts and you are a key enabler in negotiating and closing customer contracts. The role could from time to time also include work related to employment, policies, purchasing contracts, dispute resolution, regulatory compliance issues and support in M&A transactions as needed.

As a business advisor in the company, you have excellent advocacy, communication, organization and time management skills. You are a team player, responsive, and can consistently meet turnaround times in a fast-moving environment.



Role Description & Responsibilities:

 

  • Support sales and services teams in Benelux and in other EMEA countries as needed and assigned
  • Negotiate and draft software license agreements, professional services and support agreements, NDAs, distribution agreements, and other software-related contracts
  • Support Benelux-related aspects of group acquisitions and mergers, including post-acquisition or merger implementation in coordination with HQ Corporate Legal team as needed and assigned
  • Advise on general corporate and commercial matters in cooperation with HQ Corporate Legal team
  • Develop and provide employees with training materials regarding legal processes, corporate compliance, and other legal topics
  • Actively contribute to EMEA Legal Department initiatives

Qualifications:

 

  • Master's in Laws (LLM) degree 
  • Relevant experience working in an international company (ideally a stock-listed company) or a well-renowned law firm
  • Fluent in Dutch and English (including Legal English)
  • Excellent drafting skills and attention to detail
  • IT industry experience is desirable
  • Able to advise, support, and interact with internal stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills 
  • Self-starter and able to work independently and to report effectively to the management
  • Good business judgment and strategic thinking
  • Team player

We are looking for two driven, curious, and tech-savvy AI & Supply Chain Optimization Interns to join our Supply Chain Optimization team in Den Bosch, the Netherlands.
As part of the team, you will apply cutting-edge AI tools to support real-world planning and optimization challenges across Rail, Workforce, Logistics and Manufacturing, while gaining valuable hands-on experience.
In this role, you will work closely with senior domain experts and a fellow intern in a collaborative environment that encourages peer learning, knowledge sharing and problem-solving. From your first day, you will receive direct mentorship from experienced team members while collaborating with colleagues from diverse cultural backgrounds across our global organization.

Role description & Responsibilities

  • Leverage modern AI tools and techniques to build, automate, and refine:
    o    Interactive solution capability demos for internal and client stakeholders 
    o    Test case generation and test automation workflows
    o    Standard project, system, and process documentation 
  •  Assist senior team members in designing, modeling and validating supply chain planning solutions
  • Apply analytical models to industry-specific challenges in Rail, Workforce, Logistics and Manufacturing operations
  • Present findings, proof-of-concept demos and automated workflows clearly to cross-functional global stakeholders
  • Actively communicate, coordinate and collaborate with global team members from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds.
  • Work closely with your intern peer in the NL office to brainstorm solutions, share knowledge, review work and tackle complex tasks together

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Econometrics, Engineering, Computer Science or another related quantitative or technical field
  • Professional-level English, both written and spoken
  • Practical experience or strong familiarity with AI tools (e.g., LLM APIs, code-generation tools, workflow automation) to streamline documentation, create demos and generate test cases.
  • Academic or hands-on understanding of Supply Chain Planning & Optimization principles
  • Knowledge of or strong interest in at least one of the following domains:
    o    Rail Planning / Workforce Scheduling / Logistics Operations
    o    Manufacturing Supply Chain Operations
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly, respectfully and effectively across a global team of diverse cultures, time zones and language backgrounds
  • Proactive, collaborative, open-minded and eager to learn directly from senior industry leaders and peers in an international environment

What’s in it for you

  • Exposure to real-world projects and collaboration with experienced professionals in an international, multicultural team
  • Direct mentorship and daily collaboration with senior domain experts in our Netherlands office
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered solutions and automation that support real business operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies and real-world supply chain optimization projects

Interested? Click on "Apply" to upload your application documents.
